ISTEFOX_RAG_MODEL.description: Override the embedding model (e.g. BAAI/bge-m3). Only used when RAG is enabled.

ISTEFOX_RAG_ENABLED.description: If truthy: enables the vector RAG provider.

ISTEFOX_PREVIEW_TTL_S.description: Override TTL in seconds for preview_token (default 5 minutes). Valid range: 1–3600.

ISTEFOX_WEBHOOK_TOKEN.description: Optional token for RAG webhook sync.

ISTEFOX_FAST_LIST_DATABASES.description: If truthy (1/true/yes/on): list_databases skips computing record_count (returns null). Useful on large databases.
